card.text: Gonggong is a large, distant trans-Neptunian world with the moon Xiangliu. Its smooth model follows a published thermal size interpretation; the viewing pole and surface detail are illustrative.

introduction.text: Gonggong is a large, distant trans-Neptunian world with the moon Xiangliu. Its smooth model follows a published thermal size interpretation; the viewing pole and surface detail are illustrative.

model.title: Published size model; shape unresolved
model.summary: Published spherical thermophysical interpretation, diameter 1230 ±50 km. It assumes Xiangliu orbits near Gonggong’s equatorial plane; the unknown local surface is shown with the grid. Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
